bias.reason: Thursday's pivot is 7348–52: Wednesday's midpoint (7388.75 / 7305.25 → 7347) and the 7351–52 shelf, the first target off the 7305–09 Failed Breakdown. The structure is still bearish and basing. Wednesday opened 7371 after an overnight high of 7434.75, topped 7388.75, then sold to 7305.25 — a second sweep of Tuesday's 7308–09 low — and recovered again through the 7320–23 / Nov 5 7323 zone. ES closed 7340.25 at 3:59 PM ET (SPX 7323.64, −0.23%; SPY 730.20, −0.31%, first close under the 200-day average; QQQ 659.51, +0.39%; VIX 24.63). After the close ES has traded 7332–7350 so far, last 7345.75 at 1:28 PM PT, still around the 7348–52 pivot. Two sweeps of 7305–09 both recovered, so 7320–23 is the line into Friday's OpEx. Every expiry is negative gamma; SPY and SPX both sit on their weekly floors (730 / 7300). A hold of 7348–52 and a reclaim of 7372–73 opens 7388, then 7421 (the bull/bear line, just outside the plan band). Acceptance above 7421 opens 7455. Lose 7320 and accept below 7305 (a lost Failed Breakdown) and the path is 7275, then SPX 7250 / ES ≈ 7270, both below the plan band. 7340–7360 is chop — skip the middle. The unpadded plan band is 7305.25–7388.75 (Wednesday regular session union the after-hours range so far, 7332–7350). Padded by 0.25 × Thursday's implied move (SPX ±1.09%, about 80 points) to about 7285–7409. ES ≈ SPX + 19.5 from Wednesday's regular-session median. Jobless claims and Philly Fed are at 5:30 AM PT; Fed Jefferson 6:25 AM PT; Fed Goolsbee and the Anthropic debut around 9:30 AM PT — no new size into the IPO open; 10-year bond sale at 10:00 AM PT.
